purpose: Negative control for the client-navigation audit's visibility predicate: prove a page left in the pre-fix hidden state is rejected.
navigation: temporary anchor, dispatched click handled by useClientNav (same path as the audit)
simulation: After a real client navigation, remove .rv-in from .rv-scope main and force the first heading and its .rv-word spans to opacity 0. This reproduces the pre-fix state (reveal never re-ran); it does not modify any app file.
result: The real post-fix page passes; the simulated pre-fix page fails the same predicate the audit uses, so the 44/44 green baseline is not vacuous.
